{"metadata":{"description":"A proactive rate limiter plugin for DeepSeek Harness.","id":"gh:1337254484","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-rate-limiter","slug":"Xidong-AI/dsh-rate-limiter","topics":["429","dsh","dsh-plugin","linuxdo","rate-limiter","too-many-requests"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A proactive rate limiter plugin for DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-rate-limiter"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A **proactive rate limiter** plugin for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`): it controls the request rate **per"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" provider** (token bucket) **before** model requests are issued, and **queues the request with a del"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ay** instead of failing when the limit is exceeded — avoiding upstream 429s."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It complements the official `dsh-llm-retry` (exponential backoff after failure): rate limiting comes"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" first (prevention), backoff comes last (safety net); the two do not interfere with each other."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- Per-provider token bucket, enforced **before** the request is sent (proactive prevention)
- Over-l"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"imit requests are queued with a delay instead of rejected (no 429s, no lost requests)
- Unconfigured"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" providers pass through untouched (zero intrusion)
- Queued waits honor the abort signal: stopping t"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"he user interrupts the wait immediately
- Hand-written reservation-based token bucket (concurrency-s"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"afe), zero third-party rate-limiting dependencies
- Mounts on `agent/request`, coexists naturally wi"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"arty rate-limiting dependencies
- Mounts on `agent/request`, coexists naturally with `dsh-llm-retry`"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Install from npm:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"> npm registry URLs are case-sensitive; use the lowercase package name."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Or install directly from GitHub:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"For local development, add the checkout directly:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"After installing, `dsh --profile web --dump-config` should show the plugin entry:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Configure the token bucket per provider in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (or this plugin's `cordi"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"token bucket per provider in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (or this plugin's `cordis.patch.yml`):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- `rate`: refill rate (tokens/second), i.e. the long-term average request rate.
- `burst`: bucket ca"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"pacity, the number of burst requests allowed.
- **Providers not listed are not rate-limited**; reque"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"sts pass through untouched (zero intrusion).
- `enabled: false` disables the plugin entirely."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## How It Works"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The plugin hooks onto the `agent/request` waterfall: it `await next()` first to obtain the call conf"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ig (which carries the provider), then performs a per-provider token bucket check; when tokens are in"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"sufficient, it queues the request with a delay (interrupted immediately by the abort signal when the"},{"id":"p23s4","text":" user stops), then returns the config unchanged — it never modifies request content, never changes r"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"outing, never swallows errors. It only controls *when* a request is issued."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The rate-limiting algorithm is a hand-written reservation-based token bucket (concurrency-safe), wit"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"h zero third-party rate-limiting dependencies."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Relationship with dsh-llm-retry"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Plugin | Timing | Behavior |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| `dsh-rate-limiter` | Before the request is issued | Queue with a delay when over the limit (preven"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ts 429s) |
| `dsh-llm-retry` | After the request fails | Exponential backoff retry (safety net) |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"They mount at different points (`agent/request` vs `agent/request-error`) and coexist naturally."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Runtime feature detection lets one build run on both dsh 0.1.x and 0.2.x
